data.rationale: The proposal follows the same end-to-end sequence (Wikipedia, timeanddate, Booking, two Viator searches, OpenTable, Notes, Mail) with essentially the right parameters, but it omits the review score of 8+ hotel criterion, the "do not click Reserve/Book/Send" constraints, the Discard step, and the activity and restaurant details to record. It also hardcodes the dinner time as 19:30 instead of using the first available evening time, has no companion@example.com email rule, and adds a vague "Next month if needed" date step, which makes it less automatable.
